item.title: Letters to the Editor, March 10, 2026
item.description: ANY DIFFERENCE? What’s the difference between supreme leaders Khomeini and Hitler? It isn’t that both wanted the total extinction of Jews and used global terror to try to make the world compliant to their dictates. The difference is that when Hitler died, Nazi acolytes didn’t parade in downtown Toronto with a gurney shouting “Heil Hitler.” […]

item.title: SUNshine Girl Jessica
item.description: SUNshine Girl Jessica is into modelling, TV acting and doing promotions. Our 5-foot-4 brunette has a thing for riding her motorcycle and being at the beach, while her two guilty pleasures are reading author Cerise Fairfax and slipping on her headphones and listening to hip hop. (JACK BOLAND/TORONTO SUN)
